title: The Sacred Courtyard
description: A celebration of South Indian heritage, where intricately crafted wooden structures, traditional brass accents and hand-strung florals come together. Rooted in cultural richness, the setting reflects the warmth and authenticity of a traditional wedding.

title: The Eternal Root
description: A sacred Banyan tree adorned with brass bells and traditional elements becomes the heart of this celebration. Framed by carved wooden panels and cascading crimson and white florals, the design honours Krishna through an expression of heritage and devotion.

title: The Eternal Sanctuary
description: Inspired by the architectural beauty of South Indian temples, this design brings together traditional gopuram elements, delicate floral arrangements and gilded accents. Every detail draws from the richness of ancient rituals, creating an atmosphere of cultural elegance.

title: The Sacred Gilded Union
description: A celebration where sacred symbolism meets regal elegance. Traditional architectural motifs, rich golden florals and intricate detailing create a setting that honours the beauty of Indian wedding traditions with a refined, contemporary sensibility.

title: The Handcrafted Vow
description: Inspired by the artistry of Kalamkari, this wedding design celebrates Indian craftsmanship through a palette of ivory and crimson. Ornate brass accents, handcrafted details and organic textures come together to create a setting that feels both traditional and beautifully contemporary.

title: Gilded Devotion
description: Drawing inspiration from South Indian temple architecture and the divine symbolism of Lakshmi and Vishnu, this design features intricate floral domes, brass accents and a refined ivory-and-gold palette. A celebration of tradition interpreted through thoughtful craftsmanship.

title: A Tapestry of Two Roots
description: A celebration where Kerala's timeless charm meets the cultural richness of Telugu traditions. Inspired by the beauty of both heritages, this wedding design brings together traditional elements, vibrant florals and thoughtful detailing, creating a setting that celebrates two cultures coming together in love and harmony.

title: The Sophisticated Romantic
description: Set against the serenity of a lakeside setting, this design brings together delicate blooms, shimmering crystals and the warmth of candlelight. A romantic atmosphere where natural beauty and understated luxury complement one another.

title: The Palace of Petals
description: Against the grandeur of a majestic Mahal, soft florals in ivory, lavender and blush pink create a dreamlike setting. Inspired by the divine love of Radha and Krishna, the design balances architectural elegance with the delicate beauty of a blooming garden.

title: Sculpted in Bloom
description: A contemporary interpretation of traditional Telugu wedding decor. Cascading floral installations, delicate pink accents and softly layered textures frame the sacred rituals, creating a setting that feels both elegant and deeply rooted in tradition.

title: The Blush Vrindavan
description: Inspired by the romantic gardens of Vrindavan, this design features soft pink and white florals, graceful architectural details and delicate arrangements. A celebration of romance brought to life through gentle colours and thoughtfully layered elements.

title: The New Classic
description: An exploration of contemporary wedding design, bringing together bold ideas, sculptural elements and refined detailing. With a balance of modern sophistication and artistic expression, the setting offers a fresh interpretation of celebratory luxury.

title: Ethereal Gardens
description: A romantic garden-inspired design filled with lush florals, soft ivory tones and elegant architectural elements. Carefully layered arrangements create an atmosphere that feels fresh, graceful and effortlessly sophisticated.

title: Morning Mist & Rose
description: Inspired by the quiet beauty of a garden at daybreak, this intimate setting combines soft blush florals, airy ivory fabrics and delicate botanical elements. The result is a serene, romantic atmosphere defined by natural beauty and understated elegance.

title: Crystalline Whimsy
description: A contemporary Sangeet setting where cascading crystals, delicate greenery and warm lighting come together. Designed in a palette of ivory and gold, the space blends modern elegance with an enchanting, garden-inspired atmosphere.

title: Red Revelry
description: A bold Sangeet celebration defined by deep red velvet, dramatic florals and shimmering crystal details. Rich textures and statement installations create an atmosphere of glamour, romance and festive energy.

title: The Crimson & Olive Gallery
description: A dramatic reception setting that brings together deep olive drapery, rich crimson florals and sculptural white accents. Layered fabrics, ambient lighting and refined detailing transform the space into an immersive celebration of contemporary luxury.

title: Radiance in Bloom
description: A vibrant Pellikuthuru celebration that blends traditional elements with contemporary styling. Rich floral arrangements, colourful accents and thoughtfully curated details create a warm, festive setting that honours the beauty of this meaningful ritual.

title: The Earthy Haldi
description: Inspired by earthy textures and traditional Indian elements, this Haldi celebration features burnt-orange florals, terracotta accents, handwoven baskets and nostalgic pickle jars. A warm, vibrant setting that celebrates heritage with a playful design approach.

title: Intimate Gatherings
description: An intimate celebration of 80 beautiful years, designed around warmth, togetherness and meaningful details. Thoughtful floral arrangements and carefully curated elements create a welcoming setting for a special gathering with close family.

title: Traces of Tradition
description: A traditional Sreemantam celebration designed with carved wooden elements, sacred idols and elegant brass accents. Deep violet tones, earthy textures and intricate architectural detailing create a warm, culturally rooted setting honouring the mother-to-be.
